rules.title: camelCase identifiers
rules.text: Use camelCase for variables and functions.

rules.title: snake_case identifiers
rules.text: Use snake_case for variables and functions.

rules.title: PascalCase types
rules.text: Use PascalCase for classes, types and components.

rules.title: PascalCase component files
rules.text: Name component files in PascalCase, matching the component they export.

rules.title: Boolean prefixes
rules.text: Prefix booleans with is, has, can or should.

rules.title: No cryptic abbreviations
rules.text: Use descriptive names; avoid single-letter names outside tiny loops and avoid unclear abbreviations.

rules.title: Behavior-based test names
rules.text: Name tests after the behavior they verify, for example "returns an error when the token is expired".

rules.title: No type prefixes
rules.text: Do not encode types in names (strName, IUser) unless the language idiom requires it.

rules.title: Verb names for functions
rules.text: Name functions with verbs and values with nouns.

rules.title: Plural collections
rules.text: Name collections in the plural and single items in the singular.

rules.title: Units in names
rules.text: Include units in names when not obvious, such as timeoutMs or sizeBytes.

rules.title: Use domain vocabulary
rules.text: Use the domain terms from the product and docs consistently instead of inventing synonyms.

rules.title: Avoid negated names
rules.text: Avoid negated boolean names such as isNotReady.
